scope: Deeper charger-fault access, corrected ADC sequencing, contact bias sensing, recovery entry

macComparison.interpretation: Mac right differs consistently from the working right under identical stock contact/bias settings; Mac left overlaps working left. Raw counts are not calibrated supply voltage, current, or battery voltage. This does not distinguish deep discharge, contact/load variation, charger failure, or corrupted firmware.

measurementQualification.sequenceCorrection: Stock samples after mux write and settle, before any register reads. Revised bridge mirrors this order. Corrected water reference remains about 4 raw counts.
measurementQualification.adcConfiguration: Sequencer channel 4 in rank 1; unused ranks F. Checked 12-bit resolution and sequencer mode before any YHM writes.
measurementQualification.contactStatusQualification: Temporarily disabling left/right output changes status register 1 to 0x10/0x01. Exact values are checked; all ten registers are restored afterward.
measurementQualification.interpretation: Contact/bias ADC values are electrical-response measurements, not calibrated voltage/current. No battery diagnosis can be inferred from raw counts alone.

bq25180.FLAG0: 0x02: sticky events; read-to-clear, so not a side-effect-free query
bq25180.endpointBoundary: No verified stock Case command forwarding these I2C reads from a nonresponsive temple.

npm1300.endpointBoundary: 16-bit local I2C register access; actual charger family on Mac right remains unverified. Case SRAM execution does not give Apollo memory or I2C access.

recoveryControls.DEAE00: Source-derived Case flag enables temple reset handling; acknowledged and tested in reset-gate-and-bilateral.json. Not a bootloader/DFU enable.
recoveryControls.DEB0: Traced temple reset request, not firmware programming.
recoveryControls.DEEE: Case standby/ship mode; blocked with USB present; not temple recovery.
recoveryControls.DEFF: Case MCU reset, not a temple bootloader restore.
recoveryControls.EvenBootloader: Application installs staged image after CRC/header checks. No verified exposed serial recovery listener from its DFU task.
recoveryControls.AmbiqSBL: Requires per-device INFOC/INFO0 wired configuration, entry condition, matching pins/framing/window and live CRC-valid STATUS. Existing probe has not established early-window access.
recoveryControls.memoryLayers: Ambiq SBL 0x00400000..0x00410000 is distinct from Even bootloader 0x00410000 and application 0x00438000; bulk erase or unknown boot-control writes are not justified.

EvenBootManager.behavior: At startup sends DFU queue command 1 to install staged image when flag matches; otherwise command 0 to attempt application boot. Reviewed subsequent manager loop has no periodic installation retry or rollback.
EvenBootManager.boundary: No live right-temple flag or staged-file read; no Case-accessible flag setter verified. This is a source-supported failure mechanism, not diagnosis of this device.

rejectedUnqualifiedCommands.arbitraryYhmRegisterScan: No verified ADC result map or read-side-effect specification; not used.

orangeIndicatorInvestigation.userObservation: Mac pair in either Case: orange 1 second on, 1 second off
orangeIndicatorInvestigation.officialMeaning: Charging anomaly, attributed to charging-pin alignment. Not an explicit dead-battery or DFU indication.

sourceEvidence.08007214: Both contact flags can be true while a missing temple status reply triggers unknown charging status; right no-response counter triggers reset at multiples of 180 unless reset-disabled flag is set.
sourceEvidence.0800bb4c: LED state 3 or 4 preserves blinking and toggles PA6.
sourceEvidence.08009d70: LED states 3 and 4 are deliberately not cleared by normal clear timer.
sourceEvidence.08003848: Below 90 percent selects PA6, consistent with official orange mapping; PA7 for >=90 percent.
sourceEvidence.0800bb74: Status confirmation timer starts at 1000 ticks; this alone does not establish the LED toggle period.

orangeIndicatorInvestigation.boundary: Exact 1 second LED toggle period and live LED state byte have not been independently captured. Contact detection is not proof of full power/UART continuity. Pattern is consistent with missing right status, not unique to mechanical misalignment.
orangeIndicatorInvestigation.safeNextStep: Inspect and clean dry contacts, confirm spring movement without metal tools, reseat and compare stock status. No unknown charger configuration, boot control, or firmware writes.

postContactCheck.userInspection: Contacts clean; working iPhone pair works in both Cases; Mac pair orange flashes in both Cases.
postContactCheck.observed: Mac left reports 98% charging, both contacts detected, right status times out.

earlyRecoveryProgress.initialQualificationFailure: Without reviewed UART/GPIO cleanup, status register 2 changed 04 to 0C despite zero YHM writes. Original failure retained; adding exact reviewed peripheral cleanup restored all ten bytes. No unknown YHM register writes used.
earlyRecoveryProgress.next: Awaiting Mac pair swap for fixed HELLO timing-window coverage after one reset request.
earlyRecoveryProgress.firstImmediateInterpretation: Transmitted HELLO echo plus zero; no CRC-valid STATUS. Receive-path control is not yet qualified, so this is not conclusive recovery-unavailable evidence.
earlyRecoveryProgress.olderBridgeReceiveIssue: Pinned SBL V7 bridge calls native 0x08006CF8 (TX-only) before raw receive. Stock 0x0800258C calls 0x08006C80 (RX-only) after TX. Do not rely on old raw-receive silence as SBL availability evidence. Physical positive control still pending.
earlyRecoveryProgress.leftControlInterpretation: Earlier left controls used right-destination byte; RX path has not passed a checksum-valid application reply. Correctly addressed control in progress.
earlyRecoveryProgress.receiveLoopCorrection: 0x08002CB8 calls a blocking GPIO pulse-train helper at 0x0800A270, not a generic harmless watchdog feed. Removing it from the RX loop changed a framing-error/zero-byte control to a complete checksum-valid reply. Direct IWDG register feeding remains.

qualifiedRightEarlyProbeResult.resetBoundary: Bridge completed stock Case reset waveform; actual right Apollo reset is not independently observed.

qualifiedWindowedHello.boundary: One stock reset waveform emitted; actual Apollo reset and retail boot configuration remain unobserved. No firmware data sent.

remainingRecoveryInvestigation.officialAmbiqGuides: Secure Update and MRAM Recovery downloads redirected to account/profile request; not accessed or bypassed.
remainingRecoveryInvestigation.peerUartLead: Exact dispatch literal 0x0057016C resolves to 0x0057303D, opcode 0x43. Fixed seven bytes ptSync are sent and compared to echo. This is an application UART sync test, not a demonstrated arbitrary relay or bootloader recovery entry; not sent.

interruptedOfficialOtaFollowup.applicationCompletion: Pinned main function 0x00445660 compares calculated CRC (transfer word0x17) with expected CRC (command+0x10) before setting 0x55555555 through 0x00478860. Literal strings confirm CRC semantics.
interruptedOfficialOtaFollowup.bootloaderComponent: Separate main function 0x00444F60 copies staged bootloader file to MRAM in 4096-byte chunks; requires running temple application.
interruptedOfficialOtaFollowup.installationError: Pinned bootloader 0x0042DE0E writes four erased words to update record 0x007FE000 then calls 0x0042E514 mode0. Reconstructed control.c maps mode0 to RSTGEN SWPOR write at0x40000008, followed by spin pending reset.
interruptedOfficialOtaFollowup.interpretation: Phone interruption is a credible lead but does not identify failed component or prove persistent flag-loop. No temple memory readout available.
